description: This Java class 'OrderTotal' represents an order total entity in a sales management system. It contains fields such as title, code, order, module, and value, with corresponding getters and setters, and extends a base 'Entity' class.

classes.name: OrderTotal
classes.description: Represents an order total line item with attributes like title, code, order index, module, and monetary value.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the order total.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the order total.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code identifying the order total.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code for the order total.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order index for sorting order totals.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Sets the order index for sorting order totals.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module name associated with this total.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the module name associated with this total.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the monetary value of the order total.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the monetary value of the order total.
